title: Magenta RealTime 2: Open and Local Live Music Models
summary: Google Magenta's RealTime 2 is an open-source project enabling real-time AI-powered music generation that runs locally without cloud dependency. It builds on Google's music AI research to provide low-latency models suitable for live performances, giving musicians and creators more control over AI-assisted music creation.
problem_solved: Enables real-time AI music generation that runs locally without internet or cloud services, addressing latency and privacy concerns for live performance use cases.
why_valuable: Provides open, local AI music models that democratize access to real-time generative music tools for live performances while maintaining user privacy and reducing latency.
